name: Diplomatic Theologian
body:
Your study of theology and the scriptures of your faith makes you better able to relate to people.

Prerequisite(s): 5 ranks in Knowledge (religion), Charm or Nobility Domain.

Benefit(s): For every 5 ranks you possess in Knowledge (religion) you gain a +1 competence bonus to Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.
